sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fitness Biometric Tracking and Wellness Telemetry Apps

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA), signed 29 June 2010
Cross-Strait Agreement on Investment Protection and Facilitation, signed 22 August 2012
Cross-Strait Agreement on Intellectual Property Rights Protection and Cooperation, signed 29 June 2010

No formal PRC-Taiwan BIT is in force; investment access is governed by the Statute Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area (Taiwan Area-Mainland Area Relations Statute) and the Regulations Governing Investment Permissions for Investors from the Mainland Area.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Control Act (Money Laundering Prevention Act), as amended 2017-2024, implementing FATF recommendations; Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (Counter-Terrorism Financing Act or Counter-Terrorism Financing Law) transposing UN Security Council sanctions; Company Act, Article 22-1 (2018 amendment) establishing the government-only Company Beneficial Owner Information Filing Platform (Company Responsible Persons and Major Shareholders Information Filing Platform) with a 10% major-shareholder reporting duty; Regulations Governing Investment Permissions for Investors from the Mainland Area (Mainland Area Investors Investment Permits Regulations); Investment Commission mainland-investment negative list and review criteria; Personal Data Protection Act for cross-strait transfer of health and fitness telemetry data; enforcement rules for internal controls and audit of AML/CFT for non-financial businesses and professions (DNFBPs).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Parent company business license (Business License) of the mainland China parent investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation, PRC (market regulation bureau in the parent's domicile)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization and Verification: mainland notarization by a PRC notary public office (Notary Public), then verification by the Straits Exchange Foundation (Straits Exchange Foundation); Taiwan does not recognize PRC Hague Apostilles for mainland-origin documents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association and all amendments (Company Charter)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent company shareholders' meeting or board of directors; filed with the PRC market regulation bureau
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization and Verification: PRC notarization plus Straits Exchange Foundation verification; original notarial certificate attached.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Shareholder register, capitalization table, and identity documents of all shareholders owning 25% or more of the mainland parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent company; certification by PRC notary public office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization and Verification: PRC notarization plus Straits Exchange Foundation verification; passport and ID copies individually certified.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited financial statements for the most recent fiscal year and bank reference evidence confirming lawful source of investment funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC certified public accountant (CPA) firm and a bank in the People's Republic of China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization and Verification: notarized accountant's report and bank letter, verified by Straits Exchange Foundation; financial statements must be current within 90 days.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution or shareholders' resolution authorizing the outbound investment in Taiwan and approving the intended Taiwan company name and business scope
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent company board of directors or shareholders' general meeting
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization and Verification: PRC notarization plus Straits Exchange Foundation verification.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney and certified identity documents for the Taiwan entity's legal representative or locally engaged manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC notary public office for mainland representatives; Taiwan household registration and ID for Taiwanese representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Mainland representatives: PRC notarization plus Straits Exchange Foundation verification; Taiwanese representatives: no external legalization required beyond ordinary identity certification; if representative is a PRC national, cross-strait verification applies.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP (politically exposed persons) identification, domestic and international, on all shareholders, directors, supervisors, beneficial owners, and the mainland parent's senior management under the Money Laundering Control Act, Articles 7 and 8, and the AML/CFT internal-control regulations applicable to DNFBPs; mandatory screening against UN Security Council sanctions as transposed by the Counter-Terrorism Financing Act; in operational practice, Taiwanese clearing banks also apply OFAC SDN screening to USD wire transfers associated with the Apple IAP and Google Play Billing payment rails; additional screening is required against the Ministry of Economic Affairs Investment Commission mainland-investment negative list and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs domestic sanctions list; the AML risk tier is recorded as Low-Risk-Standard for a digital health application with no statutory license requirement, subject to annual independent AML audit review.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commerce - Company and Commerce One-Stop Online Application System (Company and Commerce and Limited Partnership One-Stop Online Application and Registration System), including the company name and business scope pre-approval enquiry module (Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval Enquiry System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official registered company name must be in Traditional Chinese characters; simplified Chinese characters from the mainland parent name are converted to Traditional Chinese at registration; a Latin-script English name may be registered as an annex to the Chinese name but cannot replace it; the name must be clearly distinguishable from any existing registered or pre-approved name in the same or similar industry; the translation and transliteration of the mainland parent's name must be consistent across the mainland investment permit application, the notarized corporate documents, and the Taiwan company registration.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Health Food with efficacy claims (Health Food)
China (China) - sensitive token requiring Investment Commission and cross-strait review for mainland-funded applicants
Financial derivatives and fund-management related tokens requiring Financial Supervisory Commission approval
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A favorable name pre-approval is valid for six months and may be extended once for a further six months by application before expiry if incorporation has not yet been completed; upon a negative pre-approval decision, the applicant may (i) re-file a revised name enquiry online through the One-Stop system without penalty, (ii) within 30 days of service of the rejection, file an administrative appeal with the Ministry of Economic Affairs under the Administrative Appeal Act, and (iii) after an adverse appeal determination, initiate administrative litigation before the Taipei High Administrative Court within two months of service under the Administrative Litigation Act; the appeal must specify the statutory or factual error in the application of the Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval Review Guidelines.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or registered-agent address is legally permissible as the principal office of a general service company under the Company Act, provided the address is a physical location in Taiwan capable of receiving service of process and the registered agent executes the required civil-law service-of-process acceptance. However, for a mainland-funded health and fitness tracker collecting Taiwanese users' biometric and health telemetry data, a bare virtual office will not satisfy the operational substance expectations of the Investment Commission's post-investment audit nor the accountability requirements of the Personal Data Protection Act and the mainland investment permit conditions; a serviced office with a local manager, local data-processing capability, or a documented lawful cross-border transfer mechanism is strongly recommended.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 30-40% probability of an unannounced Investment Commission post-investment audit during the first 12 months of operation for a mainland-funded operator in the digital health and personal-data-sensitive sector; 10-15% probability per year thereafter for routine compliance spot-checks by the Department of Commerce, labor inspection authorities, and tax administration; for a purely domestic ISIC 6201 non-sensitive software company, the equivalent random inspection probability is approximately 5-8% per registry statistics.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name pre-approval (name pre-screening) enquiry fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commerce (Company and Commerce One-Stop Online System)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: NT$300 per name enquiry, payable online

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mainland Area investor investment permission application (Mainland Investment Permit) - filing, liaison, and response to Investment Commission supplementary-review queries
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: NT$10,000-12,000 (approximately USD 320-390) inclusive of professional drafting and submission

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company incorporation registration fee for a limited company (Limited Company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Offices (One-Stop Online Registration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: NT$1,000 base registration fee plus NT$2 per NT$1,000 of registered capital over NT$400,000 (approximately NT$2,000 at NT$500,000 registered capital)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cross-strait notarization of parent corporate documents (business license, articles of association, shareholder register, board resolution, financial statements, and identity certificates)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC notary public office (Notary Public) in the parent company's domicile
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff/market benchmark: CNY 1,500-3,000 per notarial page bundle, depending on the notary office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Straits Exchange Foundation document verification fee (SEF verification) for notarized mainland documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Straits Exchange Foundation (Straits Exchange Foundation, Taipei)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: NT$300 per verified document, approximately 5-6 documents required

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal engraving (company chop, finance chop, contract chop, and legal representative chop)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered professional seal engraver (certified seal engraving firm)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: NT$2,000-3,000 for a standard four-seal set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office / serviced office address and registered-agent service (12 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial serviced-office provider (business center) or real-property lessor; registered agent service retained
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: NT$25,000-35,000 per annum for a virtual or serviced office address in Taipei

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial owner and major shareholder filing under Company Act Article 22-1 (initial filing and six-month update windows)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Responsible Persons and Major Shareholders Information Filing Platform; handled by a local filing agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government e-filing imposes no statutory fee; professional service benchmark NT$5,000-6,000 per filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT compliance program design, PEP and sanctions screening subscription, and internal control manual (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed AML compliance vendor or law firm acting as DNFBP compliance adviser
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: USD 800-1,500 for a low-risk digital application operator under the Money Laundering Control Act DNFBP regime

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cross-border corporate and tax structuring legal counsel for the mainland investor route, including Taiwan negative list review, personal-data transfer assessment, escrow and payment-rail compliance advice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Retained Taipei-licensed law firm with PRC cross-border counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: USD 4,000-8,000 for a cross-strait incorporation with mainland investment permit and privacy-data review

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), Arts. 98-113 (limited company formation and governance) and Art. 387 (company registration); Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals (外國人投資條例), Arts. 4 and 8; Medical Devices Act (醫療器材管理法), Art. 21 (conditional software-as-medical-device registration); Personal Data Protection Act (個人資料保護法), Arts. 19-20 (health biometric data processing).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) - Administration of Commerce (經濟部商業發展署), one-stop company registration online system (公司與商業一站式線上申辦系統); foreign-investment approvals coordinated with the MOEA Department of Investment Review (經濟部投資審議司).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application for Limited Company (有限公司設立登記申請書), filed together with the Articles of Incorporation (公司章程), CPA Capital Verification Report (資本額查核報告), and MOEA Foreign Investment Approval Letter (投資核准函).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for ISIC 6201 software activities; the MOEA requires paid-in capital to be sufficient for establishment (足敷設立使用) in the incorporators' judgment. All capital must be fully remitted and deposited into the company's preparatory bank account (籌備處帳戶), verified by a licensed CPA Capital Verification Report, and must remain on deposit until the Company Registration Certificate issues. No statutory escrow account is required for low-risk digital health app entities.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribed registered capital and shareholder contributions, as set out in the Articles of Incorporation and the MOEA Foreign Investment Approval Letter, are hereby ratified and accepted in full. RESOLVED, that the registered office at [Taipei City, Taiwan address] is hereby adopted as the statutory address for service of process. RESOLVED, that [Name] is hereby appointed sole Director and Company Representative, and [Name] is appointed General Manager, each to serve until removed by resolution. RESOLVED, that the Director is authorized to execute and file the Company Registration Application, Unified Business Number tax registration, and all ancillary licenses with the competent authorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Administration of Commerce - Company and Commerce One-Stop Online System (公司與商業一站式線上申辦系統, gcis.nat.gov.tw)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the one-stop portal using the foreign shareholder's digital certificate (MOEACA organization certificate); submit the Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval Application (公司名稱及所營事業預查申請), proposing up to five Chinese-language company names and the English name 'CN WFOE Health Fitness App Tracker Co., Ltd.'; declare the business scope under Taiwan Standard Industrial Classification code 6201 (電腦程式設計); pay the NT$300 pre-approval fee by online payment.
required_dossiers: Company Name Pre-Approval Application Form (公司名稱及所營事業預查申請書)
Electronic declaration of proposed business scope
Copy of foreign shareholder passport / mainland China business license
Power of attorney for the local filing agent (代辦委託書)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a name-conflict or prohibited-character finding, file a revised Name Pre-Approval Application within 10 business days; re-apply using a distinctive prefix or suffix and attach a written misrepresentation indemnity. A rejected name may be re-proposed once per 30-day cooling-off period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Investment Review (經濟部投資審議司)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Foreign Investment Application (外國人投資申請書) describing the digital health and fitness app tracker business, the capitalization table, and the proposed Taiwan directors; obtain the Investment Approval Letter (投資核准函) and remittance-in authorization. The approval letter is a precondition for the preparatory bank account opening and subsequent foreign-exchange settlement of the capital contribution.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application Form (外國人投資申請書)
Certified and legalized incorporation certificate and business license of the Chinese parent investor
Parent-company board resolution authorizing the Taiwan WFOE investment
Investor audited financial statements for the latest fiscal year or bank solvency letter
Passport copies and residency certificates of Taiwan-appointed directors
Business plan for the fitness biometric tracking app, including data flow and PDPA compliance notes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Review Department requires supplementary materials on beneficial ownership or source of funds, respond within 60 days; a single 30-day written extension may be requested. Failure to cure results in dismissal; re-file with an updated application and revised capital plan.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparatory Bank Account Opening and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: FSC-licensed commercial bank in Taipei (foreign-exchange bank with DBU/OBU capacity)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a preparatory corporate account (公司籌備處活期存款帳戶) in the proposed company name; remit the paid-in capital from the Chinese parent in USD or TWD through cross-strait foreign-exchange settlement; complete the bank's foreign-exchange declaration (結匯申報); obtain the bank's Certificate of Deposit Balance (存款餘額證明) signed by the branch manager; keep the funds frozen until the Company Registration Certificate issues.
required_dossiers: Name Pre-Approval Letter (公司名稱預查核定書)
Foreign Investment Approval Letter (投資核准函)
Preparatory company seal (籌備處印章) and authorized signatory chop
Directors' passports or national IDs and specimen signature card
Bank account opening application and beneficial ownership declaration (FATCA/CRS forms)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank's AML/KYC unit places the remittance on hold, provide the source-of-funds statement, the remittance-in slip (水單), and the Investment Approval Letter; escalate to the bank's compliance officer and obtain release within 5 business days, or open an alternative FSC-licensed branch with prior notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed certified public accountant registered with the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) and the MOEA (會計師簽證)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed CPA to examine the bank deposit certificate and remittance vouchers; prepare the Capital Verification Report (有限公司資本額查核報告書), the shareholder capital contribution schedule (股東繳納股款明細表), and issue the CPA verification certificate in the form prescribed by the MOEA's company registration guidelines; submit the verified report for use in the establishment filing.
required_dossiers: Bank Deposit Balance Certificate (存款餘額證明)
Preparatory account passbook or e-statement
Share subscription schedule and remittance-in records
Executed Articles of Incorporation
Foreign Investment Approval Letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CPA queries the source or currency conversion of the capital, provide the foreign-exchange settlement certificate (買匯水單) and re-attest the report; if the bank certificate predates 7 calendar days, obtain a refreshed certificate and re-issue the verification report before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Administration of Commerce - one-stop company registration filing system (公司登記一站式申請)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in with the appointed director's natural-person certificate (自然人憑證) or the agent's digital certificate; submit the Limited Company Establishment Registration Application; upload scanned copies of the Articles of Incorporation, CPA Capital Verification Report, director consent statement (董事願任同意書), shareholder list, and address-use consent; pay the NT$1,000 registration fee; receive the electronic Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書) and the auto-issued Unified Business Number (統一編號).
required_dossiers: Company Registration Application Form (有限公司設立登記申請書)
Articles of Incorporation (公司章程) signed by all subscribers
CPA Capital Verification Report (資本額查核報告書)
Shareholders' list and director appointment consent
Registered office lease agreement and building owner's use-consent
Foreign Investment Approval Letter and remittance-in evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry serves a Deficiency Notice (補正通知), cure within 15 calendar days; if the defect is incurable, re-file the application with a newly pre-approved name and pay a reduced re-filing fee; a final rejection may be appealed to the MOEA under the Administrative Appeal Act (訴願法).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Labor, Health Insurance and Data Compliance Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau (財政部各地區國稅局); Taipei City Labor Bureau; National Health Insurance Administration (健保署); Personal Data Protection Commission (個資保護委員會)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 15 days after the registration certificate issues, apply for Business Tax Registration (營業稅稅籍登記), register as a salary withholding unit (扣繳單位設立登記), enroll employees in labor insurance and national health insurance, and file the PDPA personal data file registration for health biometric data processing; complete the Taiwan VAT-registered merchant profile and e-invoice (電子發票) integration for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing sales.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書)
Unified seal impression card (印鑑卡)
Lease agreement and office address proof
Director and shareholder national ID cards
Labor, NHI and withholding registration application forms
PDPA personal data file registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau assigns an incorrect industry class or VAT posture to app-store commissions, file a Correction Application (更正登記) with the branch's tax service desk; for Apple or Google withholding mismatches, reconcile through the Digital Economy Tax Section of the National Taxation Bureau and obtain a written valuation ruling.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health and Welfare - Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) for software-as-medical-device (SaMD) classification; Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC) for biometric and health data processing; Taipei City Fire Department and Building Administration Office for physical clearance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Conditional Medical Device Software (SaMD) Establishment and Listing License (醫療器材軟體查驗登記) - required only if the fitness app provides diagnostic or treatment guidance and is classified as a medical device; otherwise, the operating license set comprises a Low-Risk Exemption Declaration and the PDPA Personal Data Processing Registration (個人資料檔案登記).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment (MOENV) - Environmental Impact Assessment Review Committee (環境部環境影響評估審查委員會)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category D (office-based computer programming, ISIC 6201): no mandatory EIA report is required under Article 5 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act; the establishment requires only a self-administered environmental self-inspection record (污染防治紀錄) and waste contractor registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emission sources; IT equipment and e-waste must be transferred to licensed recyclers under the Waste Disposal Act (廢棄物清理法) with triplicate manifests (遞送聯單); office indoor air quality must meet CO2 ≤ 1000 ppm and PM2.5 ≤ 35 µg/m³ per the Indoor Air Quality Management Act; any standby diesel generator must comply with the Air Pollution Control Act emission standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Equipment Certification (消防安全設備檢修申報) filed with the Taipei City Fire Bureau annually; Building Public Safety Inspection Certificate (建築物公共安全檢查簽證申報) every two years for the leased office floor; Occupational Safety and Health clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act (職業安全衛生法), including statutory employee safety training, electrical equipment grounding inspection, and an emergency evacuation plan approved by the district fire station; completion of labor insurance and labor pension registration for all employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Taiwan (market jurisdiction): Ministry of Finance (財政部), National Taxation Bureau, unified e-tax portal at https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw. China (home jurisdiction): State Taxation Administration (国家税务总局), administered through the provincial or municipal e-tax bureau where the WFOE is registered.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Taiwan: foreign e-service providers without a fixed place of business must file a simplified Business Tax registration (簡易稅籍登記) through the MOF e-tax portal if direct B2C sales to Taiwan individuals exceed NT$480,000 per year, uploading the PRC business license, Unified Social Credit Code certificate, responsible person ID/passport, and articles of incorporation; the MOF then assigns a 9-digit foreign simplified taxpayer code. For revenue earned solely through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, Apple/Google act as sellers of record and are themselves registered with Taiwan's MOF for the 5% Business Tax, so no WFOE registration is required for store-channel sales; direct web (D2C) or B2B sales may trigger registration or reverse-charge duties. China: the WFOE's Unified Social Credit Code serves as its TIN, and no additional tax registration is required to claim VAT zero-rating on exported software services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope - the China WFOE, maintaining no Taiwan fixed place of business or permanent establishment, is not subject to Taiwan profit-seeking enterprise income tax on app-store remittances; Taiwan-source service or royalty income of a foreign enterprise without a PE would otherwise be withheld at 20% gross. China taxes the WFOE at entity level (CIT 25%) on worldwide income, while qualifying exported software services are VAT zero-rated.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists in Taiwan or China. Taiwan: foreign e-service providers may voluntarily register for Business Tax below the NT$480,000 threshold, may designate a tax representative, and upon establishing a PE may adopt ordinary filing positions; Taiwan's CFC/PEM elections under Income Tax Act articles 43-3 and 43-4 are unavailable to a PRC corporate taxpayer. China: the WFOE, as a general VAT taxpayer, may elect between VAT zero-rating with input-credit refund (免抵退税 mechanism) and VAT exemption without refund for eligible exported software services under Caishui [2016] No. 36, and must file the cross-border taxable service zero-rating/exemption record with the tax authority.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, with foreign-exchange banking operations conducted through authorized mainland Chinese commercial banks. This dossier assumes that CN_WFOE_LTD is a mainland China wholly foreign-owned enterprise. Taiwan is a separate legal and foreign-exchange jurisdiction; a Taiwan entity or Taiwan bank account requires a separate Taiwan regulatory analysis.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The renminbi is generally usable for current-account transactions, including genuine trade in services, software, royalties, and other documented operating payments, subject to bank review of transaction authenticity and tax compliance. Capital-account transactions remain controlled and require registration, reporting, permitted-account usage, and banking verification. Foreign-invested enterprise capital contributions generally require foreign-investment registration and capital-account processing before remittance and use. Conversion of foreign currency into renminbi is not unrestricted treasury discretion: banks assess the registered business scope, source and purpose of funds, invoices or contracts, tax evidence where applicable, and anti-money-laundering risk. Profit, dividend, interest, service-fee, royalty, and liquidation remittances are generally possible after satisfaction of corporate approvals, audited or accounting support, applicable tax filing or withholding obligations, and bank documentation requirements. Restrictions may arise from undistributed losses, unpaid taxes, inadequate statutory records, sanctions screening, related-party pricing concerns, incomplete foreign-investment reporting, or inconsistent business activity. Mainland China and Taiwan must not be treated as a single banking or FX-control perimeter; cross-strait payments may be subject to additional banking, trade, sanctions, and remittance controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Mainland China does not impose a universal rule requiring every export receipt to be converted into renminbi at a fixed percentage or within a single statutory surrender period. Export proceeds may generally be retained in permitted foreign-currency accounts or converted when commercially required, subject to genuine-trade verification, timely receipt, bank reporting, and SAFE rules. Goods-export proceeds must be collected through compliant banking channels and matched to customs, trade, and accounting records; service-export proceeds must be supported by the underlying service contract, invoice, tax materials, and evidence of performance. There is no general mandatory conversion ratio applicable to this digital-health application business. The enterprise should maintain a transaction-level reconciliation of contract, invoice, customs or service evidence, bank receipt, tax treatment, and account purpose. Banks may impose internal deadlines, documentary cutoffs, or enhanced reviews, and specific export-support, trade-finance, or regulatory programs may impose additional conditions. No receipt should be delayed, split, netted, or routed through an unrelated account without a documented legal and commercial basis.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for ancillary payment collection and treasury technology; Low as a substitute for the mandated mainland corporate banking stack. An offshore electronic-money institution or payment institution cannot generally be assumed to open or operate the PRC entity's core RMB, capital, payroll, tax, or foreign-exchange accounts. Use requires a licensed payment provider, an authorized bank, compliant cross-border payment documentation, data and cybersecurity controls, transaction monitoring, and a legally supported commercial purpose. Apple App Store and Google Play settlement flows must be reviewed separately for payer location, merchant-of-record structure, tax invoicing, foreign-exchange classification, platform withholding, chargebacks, and repatriation. Offshore collection accounts must not be used to conceal domestic sales, bypass capital-account controls, evade tax, or aggregate unrelated third-party funds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no universal statutory requirement that every foreign director appear physically at the bank. In practice, the account-opening branch may require an in-person interview with the legal representative, authorized signatory, controlling shareholder, or beneficial owner, particularly for a newly established foreign-invested enterprise, foreign-currency accounts, capital accounts, high-value transfers, or cross-border payment products. Remote video verification may be accepted on a case-by-case basis but is not guaranteed. The enterprise should prepare for branch attendance by the legal representative or authorized agent, notarized and legalized foreign corporate documents where applicable, original identity documents, Chinese translations, and verification of the registered office and actual business operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear ownership chain, nominee ownership, unexplained trust arrangements, or inability to identify the ultimate beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current constitutional documents; complete ownership chart to the natural-person ultimate beneficial owner; shareholder register; certificates of incorporation; director and officer register; notarization, apostille or legalization and certified Chinese translations where required; beneficial-owner declarations; sanctions and politically exposed person screening results; and a signed ownership-control memorandum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between registered business scope, ISIC activity, application-store business model, and proposed payment flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business licence; articles of association; foreign-investment registration records; product description; application-store agreements; privacy and data-flow map; customer and payer geography; sample customer contracts; revenue model; merchant-of-record analysis; projected monthly transaction volumes; and a board-approved banking and treasury policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital-health or biometric-data activity perceived as a regulated medical, telecommunications, data-export, or cybersecurity business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legal classification memorandum distinguishing wellness and fitness tracking from medical diagnosis or treatment; product functionality matrix; data inventory; consent and privacy notices; cybersecurity and personal-information compliance assessment; cross-border data-transfer assessment; evidence that no unlicensed medical service is provided; and any required filing, certification, or regulator correspondence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign capital contribution with incomplete registration, inconsistent remitter identity, or unclear source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital contribution resolution; capital subscription documents; foreign-investment registration evidence; remitting shareholder bank statement; source-of-funds certification; audited financial statements; tax and corporate records; SWIFT payment message; remittance-purpose description; and a bank-approved capital-account funding instruction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border receipts lacking a clear trade, service, royalty, or platform-settlement purpose
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed contracts; invoices; platform settlement statements; proof of service delivery; customer terms; transaction-level reconciliation; tax invoices or tax filing evidence; transfer-pricing support for related parties; customs documents where relevant; and an explanation of payer, beneficiary, currency, payment route, and economic substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High refund, chargeback, fraud, or third-party payment exposure from consumer application sales
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment-flow diagram; platform risk controls; refund and chargeback policy; fraud-monitoring rules; customer-support procedures; settlement reserve terms; transaction-monitoring reports; sanctions-screening controls; reconciliation reports; and evidence that the account receives only the enterprise's own operating proceeds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered address, office, personnel, website, invoices, or bank activity indicates insufficient local substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease or occupancy evidence; photographs or site-verification materials; employee and payroll records; software-development and service-provider agreements; tax registration; utility or telecommunications records; management authorization; operating budget; and a written explanation of outsourced development and cloud-service arrangements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Related-party payments, management fees, royalties, or intercompany loans with weak pricing or commercial support
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Intercompany agreements; transfer-pricing policy; benchmarking; deliverables; timesheets; invoices; withholding-tax analysis; board approvals; beneficial-owner and counterparty screening; loan registration or permitted-account evidence where applicable; and a cash-flow forecast demonstrating repayment capacity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of Taiwan, offshore, or third-country accounts in a manner inconsistent with mainland China cross-border rules
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction entity chart; separate accounting ledgers; intercompany agreements; payment-purpose matrix; evidence of each entity's tax residence and regulatory status; cross-strait legal review; bank pre-clearance; and documented prohibition on personal, nominee, or unrelated third-party accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete annual reporting, tax filings, foreign-investment reporting, or account-maintenance records
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current business licence; annual enterprise information report; tax filing receipts; audited financial statements where required; foreign-investment information reports; SAFE-related records; customs and trade records; bank reconciliation; beneficial-owner refresh package; and a compliance calendar with responsible officers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder capital through the approved foreign-invested enterprise capital account at a mainland authorized bank. Before remittance, confirm registered capital or capital subscription documentation, foreign-investment registration, permitted currency, beneficiary name and account, remitter identity, purpose code, and bank pre-clearance requirements. Use a SWIFT MT103 or equivalent bank-to-bank transfer with an accurate purpose narrative such as foreign-invested enterprise capital contribution; do not describe capital as trade settlement, loan proceeds, consulting fees, or dividend income. Retain the payment message, remitter bank statement, shareholder resolution, capital contribution agreement, source-of-funds evidence, and bank credit advice. Convert foreign currency into renminbi only through an authorized bank and only for permitted operating or capital purposes. Any shareholder loan, cash pooling, upstream dividend, or downstream intercompany financing must be assessed separately for SAFE registration, leverage or quota limits, tax, accounting, and related-party documentation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use domestic RMB clearing for local suppliers, payroll, taxes, and ordinary operating expenses. Use authorized-bank foreign-currency transfers through SWIFT MT103 for genuine cross-border service fees, software, cloud hosting, royalties, refunds, and vendor payments, supported by contracts, invoices, tax documentation, and evidence of performance. Commercial letters of credit are suitable for documentary trade transactions involving goods or structured procurement but are generally unnecessary for ordinary digital subscriptions and platform services. Documentary collections, bank remittances, and approved cross-border payment products may be used according to the underlying transaction. Each payment should identify the true beneficiary, commercial purpose, currency, invoice, contract, tax treatment, and related-party status. Do not use personal accounts, undisclosed payment aggregators, split payments, false invoices, netting, or offshore settlement to bypass FX, tax, AML, or data controls. Maintain a three-way reconciliation among general ledger, bank statement, and contract or platform settlement report.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards entered with an authorized mainland bank for documented commercial exposures, subject to bank suitability assessment, transaction verification, approved credit limits, and hedging-purpose evidence

Renminbi foreign-exchange swaps or currency swaps with an authorized financial institution where the instrument, counterparty, accounting treatment, collateral, and regulatory eligibility are confirmed in advance

Non-deliverable forwards only where the authorized bank permits the product for the relevant entity, currency, exposure, and settlement structure; NDFs must not be used to disguise capital transfers or speculative positions
Foreign-exchange options or structured hedges only after enhanced product approval, suitability review, risk disclosure, valuation, accounting, and board-authorized limits

Natural hedging through matching foreign-currency receipts and payments, centralized exposure netting where legally permitted, and timing alignment of application-platform settlements with foreign-currency vendor obligations

Prohibited or restricted practice: speculative trading, unapproved derivatives with offshore counterparties, personal or nominee hedging, undocumented related-party derivatives, and transactions lacking a genuine underlying exposure or complete bank and accounting records

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 May following the calendar tax year; generally within five months after a non-calendar fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may trigger a penalty generally equal to 10% of tax payable, subject to statutory minimum and maximum amounts; non-filing may trigger a higher penalty, tax assessment, interest, and collection measures. Taiwan has no automatic administrative strike-off solely for late income tax filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting, approval of financial statements, and allocation of profits or losses
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company records; Ministry of Economic Affairs filing only if a registrable corporate change results
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinary shareholders' meeting generally within six months after the end of each fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene or document the meeting may result in Company Act penalties, defective corporate approvals, director liability, and remedial orders. No general annual return or annual franchise tax filing applies to an ordinary private Taiwan company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate registration amendment filing for annual changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally within 15 days after a change to registered particulars, including directors, capital, business address, or other registrable matters
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted amendments may result in administrative fines and repeated enforcement. The filing fee is generally approximately NT$1,000 online or NT$1,500 by paper filing; the USD amount is indicative.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit and certification generally apply to public companies, companies subject to special regulatory rules, and private companies meeting applicable thresholds, commonly paid-in capital of at least NT$30 million or specified lower-capital thresholds based on annual revenue or total assets. Thresholds must be confirmed for the relevant fiscal year and industry.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan-IFRS for public-interest and designated entities; Taiwan GAAP for other companies unless a specific rule requires Taiwan-IFRS. Tax computations follow Taiwan tax law and may require book-to-tax adjustments.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not generally impose a standalone annual UBO confirmation for every private company. The company must maintain current information on directors, managers, shareholders holding more than 10%, and beneficial owners, and report relevant registration or ownership changes within the applicable statutory period, generally 15 days. Share transfers must be reflected in the shareholder register and reported when they create a registrable change or affect reportable ownership information.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Supervisors, where applicable
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings and Board Meetings
Accounting books and supporting accounting records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 600-2,000 annually for a registered office or address service; Taiwan does not generally require a resident statutory agent solely for company maintenance.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 3,000-15,000 for a small private company requiring CPA audit, depending on transaction volume, revenue, assets, foreign ownership, software operations, and internal control complexity.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Taxpayers may apply for a 5-year corporate income tax holiday for newly invested 'emerging important strategic industries'; R&D expenses may offset 15% of current-year tax payable subject to a 10% cap; retained earnings surtax of 5% applies unless surplus is distributed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (Form No. 0800) filed through the Ministry of Finance tax e-filing system at https://tax.nat.gov.tw; applicable to WFOE operating in Taiwan.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final return; mandatory semi-annual provisional payments on July 31 and November 30.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 5 months after fiscal year-end (calendar-year enterprises must file by May 31 of the following year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating revenue, including app subscription sales, in-app purchases and royalties from user licenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-tax-resident enterprises without a Taiwan PE are not required to file this return; Taiwan-source revenue is subject to final withholding at source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales, including cloud infrastructure, development personnel and directly allocable platform fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident with a Taiwan branch, only Taiwan branch costs are deductible if supported by invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, general and administrative expenses (marketing, finance, legal, office occupancy).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses must be recorded as Taiwan branch expenses; head-office overhead allocations are limited to reasonable arm's length amounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating income and expenses, including FX gains/losses, dividend income, interest, and asset disposal gains.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Passive Taiwan-source interest and royalties must be shown separately for final withholding reconciliation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income before loss deduction.
Loss deduction carried forward from prior tax years.
Tax payable computed at 20% on net taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents do not compute this line; the payer withholds at source and may apply DTA reductions if eligible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment tax credits, R&D credits, and minimum tax (AMT) add-on adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for non-resident withholding; branch may claim limited credits if treaty-enabled.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a monthly surcharge of 1% of the assessed tax, capped at 20%; after a tax-authority notice, non-filing can expose the taxpayer to an additional tax of up to 3x the deficiency, plus late-payment interest calculated daily. Willful fraud escalates to criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% final withholding tax on dividends distributed to foreign (non-resident) shareholders; 5% retained earnings surtax applies to undistributed surplus at the WFOE level.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder may claim reduced rates only if it supplies (1) a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) from its home tax authority; (2) a Taiwan Tax Application for Treaty Relief and beneficial ownership declaration; and (3) evidence that it is the constructive owner and is not a flow-through shell. Relief is generally effectuated by immediate lower withholding after prior approval from the Taiwan taxation administration or by refund after annual assessment; the payer must retain all documentation for five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 20% for IP royalties and 20% for debt interest paid to non-residents. Under applicable Taiwan income tax treaties, royalties and interest are commonly capped at 10%; some treaties reduce royalties to 6-15% depending on IP category. Prior treaty approval is mandatory to apply the lower rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: NT$50,000,000 (New Taiwan Dollars) of aggregate annual related-party transactions triggers mandatory Local File; a Master File is additionally required where the multinational group's consolidated annual revenue reaches NT$20,000,000,000; country-by-country reporting follows the same group threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not operate a separate Economic Substance Regulations code, but the Taiwanese tax administration applies the substance-over-form doctrine and anti-abuse rules. A WFOE lacking real offices, employees, decision-making power and business activities may be treated as a sham; related-party contracts, TP documentation, payroll and office records are audited to verify commercial substance before profit attribution or treaty benefits are granted.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to record app store settlement statements, using personal offshore accounts to divert subscriber revenue, inflating cost of sales with fictitious vendor invoices, or materially under-declaring Taiwan-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Taiwan's Tax Collection Act, fraudulent tax evasion carries imprisonment up to 5 years and a fine of up to NT$60,000; administratively, the tax authority may levy an additional tax equal to 3 times the underpaid amount, plus interest, with an enhanced surcharge of not more than 10 percentage points for clear documents fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Responsible persons are co-obligors for the company's unpaid tax; directors face civil restitution of the evaded amount, court-ordered travel bans, asset freezes, and up to 5 years imprisonment; veil-piercing applies when bad faith or corporate formalities are ignored.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Compliance Failure / Shell Arrangement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Making non-arm's length payments to foreign related parties for software licenses, management fees or profit-sharing while the Taiwan WFOE retains the digital health app's operational risk and economic substance; or failing to prepare Local and Master Files after crossing the NT$50 million threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax administration may re-price the transactions, disregard the arrangements, and impose an additional tax of up to 100% to 200% of the corrected tax deficiency, with fines under Article 43-1 of the Income Tax Act; interest and late-payment penalties accrue continuously.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the tax responsible person may be personally assessed for deficiencies after repeated failure to comply; Taiwan courts have permitted piercing to officers who knowingly sign false TP submissions, exposing them to civil damages and possible prosecution for forging accounting books.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing subscription proceeds from Apple App Store and Google Play through opaque shell accounts, rapid structuring of payments below reporting thresholds, or layering funds to obscure non-resident profit owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Taiwan's Money Laundering Control Act imposes imprisonment of up to 7 years on natural persons and corporate fines up to NT$50,000,000 for money laundering; financial institutions are required to file suspicious transaction reports and freeze assets where predicate tax fraud is indicated.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly control laundering structures are criminally liable, subject to asset forfeiture, travel bans, foreign-exchange sanctions and extradition in DTA cases; the corporate veil is pierced for sole or controlling shareholders who treat corporate assets as personal.
